image.alt: Memorinth game cover, Edition Spielwiese / Pegasus Spiele edition

fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://pegasusna.com/Memorinth-Edition-Spielwiese/PNA59045G. Pegasus North America lists Memorinth article PNA59045G since April 2020 and shows the original Edition Spielwiese base-game box, matching the English rules sheet. Reduced to 296 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The last person to have read a fairy tale becomes the starting player and receives the starting-player card, bright side up. They take the first turn.
clarifications: After the first turn, play proceeds clockwise.
internalEvidence: The Pegasus North America publisher-hosted English manual at https://pegasusna.com/media/pdf/c5/67/1e/WEB_Memorinth_Rules_EN.pdf redirected to a Pegasus CDN and returned HTTP 403 locally. A publisher-authored English booklet was retrieved from the BoardGameZ mirror. PDF page 1 was rendered and visually checked; it identifies the starting-player card and exact fairy-tale criterion. Its footer dates the booklet 13.01.20. BGG identity 298018. Mirror PDF SHA-256: 2b45ff49e49fd4c8b7646dc1c9b7f15ef1a60cbb81c5cefa63b171d781511c99. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The rules do not give a tie-break for players who read a fairy tale at the same time or a fallback if nobody remembers reading one.
